title: Working with speech and extracted information · Level 3
slo: Distinguish speech AI from information extraction in common workplace tasks.

options.rationale: This is correct because speech-to-text starts with spoken audio. Its result is written text.
This reverses the conversion direction. It describes text-to-speech.
options.better_fit: Use this when an article must be read aloud.

options.text: Finding text in a photographed form
options.rationale: This is image-text work. OCR identifies text locations in images.
options.better_fit: Use this when text must be found in a scanned form.

options.rationale: Translation changes language. Speech-to-text changes audio into text.
options.better_fit: Use this when written content must be rendered in another language.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Speech-to-text turns spoken audio into text.

exercises.question_text: Which are uses of speech technologies? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: This is correct because speech technology can create audio descriptions. Those descriptions make video content available as audio.
This is correct because speech technologies can translate spoken language. The output serves a different language audience.
This is correct because a microphone interface can accept a question and return a spoken answer. It supports a spoken exchange.

options.text: Map receipt text to expense fields
options.error_type: Confuses speech uses with document analysis
options.rationale: This describes document analysis. It interprets receipt values and maps them to fields.
options.better_fit: Use this for processing a receipt into an expense claim.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Speech technologies can describe, translate, and support spoken exchanges.

exercises.question_text: Speech recognition usually uses speech-to-text to transcribe spoken audio into text.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A recorded conversation would not be correctly described as a transcription task.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Speech recognition hears and interprets speech, usually by transcribing audio into text.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Speech-to-text is a usual form of speech recognition.

exercises.question_text: Information extraction only analyzes structured database records.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Important details in scans and recordings would be overlooked.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Information extraction finds information in unstructured sources, not only databases.

exercises.explanation: Correct. It is used for unstructured sources such as forms, images, audio, and video.

exercises.question_text: Which actions can a speech AI agent do? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: This is correct because a speech agent can interpret spoken input. Understanding the request is part of the interaction.
This is correct because an agent can act on a spoken request. Task completion is part of a full speech interaction.
This is correct because a speech agent can return an audible result. Spoken output completes the exchange.

options.text: Find text pixels in a receipt
options.rationale: This is image-text detection rather than spoken interaction. It is an OCR-related task.
options.better_fit: Use this when receipt text must be found in an image.

exercises.explanation: Correct. A speech agent can listen, act, and speak back.

exercises.question_text: Speech technology can translate spoken language between languages.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A cross-language conversation would lose this useful capability.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Speech technologies can translate spoken language between languages.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Automated translation between spoken languages is a speech use.

exercises.question_text: Using AI to find serial numbers in an image is ___.

parts.text: Using AI to find serial numbers in an image is

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A detail may be seen without naming the broader goal.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: OCR can support this work, but information extraction names finding useful details such as serial numbers.

exercises.explanation: Finding serial numbers extracts useful information from an unstructured image.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the parts to form the correct statement.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The relationship between users and applications is unclear.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Place the capability first, then its spoken interaction and participants.

exercises.correct_answer: Speech capabilities enable spoken interaction between users and AI applications
exercises.explanation: The sentence identifies the capability, the interaction type, and the parties involved.

options.rationale: This is correct because speech synthesis produces audible spoken language. It vocalizes words for a listener.
This describes speech recognition. Synthesis works in the opposite direction.
options.better_fit: Use this when spoken audio must become text.

options.rationale: This describes speech translation. Synthesis vocalizes words rather than changing languages.
options.better_fit: Use this when spoken language must be translated between languages.

options.rationale: This describes OCR. Speech synthesis works with vocalized words rather than image text.
options.better_fit: Use this when locating text in a photograph or scan.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Speech synthesis vocalizes words as spoken language.

exercises.question_text: What does optical character recognition (OCR) identify?

options.text: The location of text in an image
options.rationale: This is correct because OCR identifies where text is located in an image. It is a computer vision task.

options.text: The location of an object in an image
options.rationale: This describes object detection. OCR focuses specifically on text locations.
options.better_fit: Use this when locating a specific object in an image.

options.rationale: This describes speech recognition. OCR relies on visual input.
options.better_fit: Use this when interpreting spoken language or creating a transcript.

options.rationale: This describes language detection. OCR identifies text locations rather than a document language.
options.better_fit: Use this when determining a document's written language.

exercises.explanation: Correct. OCR identifies text locations in an image.

exercises.question_text: Reconstruct the statement from the pieces.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The source and result are mixed up.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Keep text-format information before the audible signal.

exercises.correct_answer: Text-to-speech converts text-format information into an audible signal
exercises.explanation: The sentence follows conversion from text-format input to audible output.

exercises.question_text: The computer vision technology that finds text locations in an image is ___.

parts.text: The computer vision technology that finds text locations in an image is

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The image's text locations would not be named precisely.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use OCR for text locations; information extraction is broader and speech recognition works with audio.

exercises.explanation: OCR is the computer vision technology for identifying text locations in images.
